manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball moving upward, pausing briefly at its peak, and falling, while gravity constantly pulls down.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed vertically. A blue arrow shows vertical velocity which decreases to zero at the peak and reverses. A dashed vector shows constant downward gravitational acceleration.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
